title: 第二十一章 师恩如山第二十二章 互相成全
content_zh:
;;
“何事？”九叔疑惑道。
秦尧：“别为了我的前程，委屈自己。”
九叔笑了笑：“你多想了，没那些事儿。我林九就算是求人，也不会卑躬屈膝。”
看着他“傲骨铮铮”的模样，秦尧哑然失笑：“巧了，我也是，这就叫有其徒必有其师。”
“那叫有其师必有其徒，不学无术。”九叔抬腿踢了他一脚，转头望向窗外明月：“还有时间，走吧，随我去地府……”
上古时期，阳间通往阴间的入口有很多，其中大部分都在不同城市的城隍庙中，神鬼出入阴阳两界极为方便。
如今阳间灵气枯竭严重，阴司高层为防止阴间灵气源源不断的流入阳间，严令封闭了绝大多数入口，除了五方鬼帝镇守的五座地府门户外，只有少数宗门保留下了去往阴间的通道。
茅山派祖上曾经阔过，当时便留下了教中的阴阳门户。时过境迁，沧海桑田，茅山在岁月的动荡中分裂成内茅与外茅，内茅高于外茅，以阴阳门户为中心群居，平常也能借助着门户中散溢出来的阴间灵气修行。如若修炼有成，不恋凡尘，即可遁入冥府，踏上新的征程。
正因如此，茅山派哪怕愈发没落了，在修行界亦是名门！
“拜见师兄。”
“拜见师叔。”
“拜见师伯。”
……
趁着夜色，九叔带秦尧与女鬼疾速赶至茅山，在守山弟子们的一道道招呼声中，穿过一排排宫殿，直达大茅峰峰顶，停步在三宫五观之一的九霄万福宫前。
茅山中通往阴间的门户就在这万福宫四进殿之一的二圣殿门前，名曰：飞升台。
传闻之中，茅山派的创始人茅盈，也就是三茅真君中的大茅真君，便是在这座飞升台上得道成仙，驾鹤西去的。
“外茅弟子林九，申请入宫。”站在入门口高高的白色石阶前，九叔拱手拜道。
红色外墙中央处的黑色大门缓缓开启，自其中走出一名身披青色道袍的女子。
面如白玉，眼似桃花，一根木枝盘住三千青丝长发。

风起时，道袍簌簌，宛若湖中水光，波光潋滟，自成一派出尘景象。
望着这名仿佛带着光芒而来的女子，秦尧眉峰微微一扬。
活了两世，却是第一次在现实中见到比网红直播区还漂亮的女子。
“拜见秋师叔。”就在秦尧思绪纷飞之际，九叔一丝不苟的恭敬行礼。
秦尧：“……”
这妹子是九叔的师叔，那我岂不是要喊师叔祖？
可啪。
呸。
可怕！
“什么事情？”秋云水目光淡然的扫视过面前的两人一鬼，下意识在秦尧身上多停留了一会儿。
不是因为他相对于凡人来说变态级的身躯，而是因为总感觉他看向自己的目光有些奇怪。
“弟子想要将这女鬼送往阴间，换取阴德，还请师叔给个方便。”九叔指了指董小玉，轻声说道。
秋云水：“你还是不愿进入内茅吗？”
九叔静默片刻，呼出一团白气：“还是和以前一样，两成利让给师门。”

"What's the matter?" Uncle Jiu asked confused.
Qin Yao: "Don't wrong yourself for the sake of my future."
Uncle Jiu smiled: "You're overthinking it, it's none of that. Even if I, Lin Jiu, ask for help, I won't grovel."
Looking at his "arrogant and proud" appearance, Qin Yao laughed dumbly: "What a coincidence, so am I. It is said that like a disciple, there must be a teacher."
"Like a teacher, like a disciple. If you don't learn, you will have no skills." Uncle Jiu raised his leg and kicked him, then turned to look at the bright moon outside the window: "There is still time, let's go, follow me to the underworld..."
In ancient times, there were many entrances from the Yang world to the underworld, most of which were in the City God's Temple in different cities. It was extremely convenient for gods and ghosts to enter and exit the Yin and Yang realms.
Nowadays, the spiritual energy of the Yang world is seriously depleted. In order to prevent the spiritual energy of the underworld from flowing into the Yang world, the senior officials of the Yin Division have strictly ordered to seal most of the entrances. Except for the five gates of the underworld guarded by the ghost emperors of the five directions, only a few sects have retained the passage to the underworld.
The ancestors of the Maoshan sect were once rich, and at that time they left behind the yin and yang portal of the sect. As time passed and the world changed, Maoshan split into Inner Mao and Outer Mao in the turmoil of the years. The Inner Mao is higher than the Outer Mao. They live in groups centered on the Yin and Yang portal. They can also practice with the help of the underworld spiritual energy that overflows from the portal. If you succeed in cultivation and no longer love the mortal world, you can escape into the underworld and embark on a new journey.
Because of this, even if the Maoshan sect becomes increasingly declining, it is still a famous sect in the world of spiritual practice!
"Meet Senior Brother."
"Meet Uncle Master."
"Meet Master."
…
Taking advantage of the darkness, Uncle Jiu led Qin Yao and the female ghost to Maoshan Mountain quickly. Amid the greetings from the disciples guarding the mountain, they passed through rows of palaces and reached the top of Damao Peak, stopping in front of Jiuxiao Wanfu Palace, one of the Three Palaces and Five Temples.
The gateway to the underworld in Maoshan is in front of the Second Holy Temple, one of the four entrance halls of Wanfu Palace, which is called the Feishengtai.
According to rumors, Mao Ying, the founder of Maoshan Sect, also known as Da Mao Zhenjun among the Three Mao Zhenjuns, attained Taoism and became an immortal on this ascension platform and rode the crane to the west.
"Lin Jiu, a disciple of Waimao, applies to enter the palace." Standing in front of the high white stone steps at the entrance, Uncle Jiu bowed his hands and bowed.
The black door in the center of the red exterior wall slowly opened, and a woman wearing a blue robe walked out.
The face is like white jade, the eyes are like peach blossoms, and a wooden branch is entangled with three thousand long black hair.
When the wind blows, the Taoist robes rustle, just like the water in the lake, and the ripples are shining, creating a worldly scene of its own.
Looking at this woman who seemed to come with light, Qin Yao raised his eyebrows slightly.
After living for two lifetimes, this was the first time I saw a woman more beautiful than the internet celebrity live broadcast in real life.
"Greetings to Uncle Qiu." Just as Qin Yao's thoughts were racing, Uncle Jiu saluted meticulously and respectfully.
Qin Yao: "..."
This girl is Uncle Jiu’s uncle, so shouldn’t I call her uncle?
But snap.
Pooh.
horrible!
"What's going on?" Qiu Yunshui glanced at the two people and one ghost in front of him indifferently, and subconsciously stayed on Qin Yao for a while longer.
It's not because of his abnormal body compared to ordinary people, but because I always feel that the way he looks at me is a little strange.
"This disciple wants to send this female ghost to the underworld in exchange for virtue, so I would like to ask Uncle Master for a convenience." Uncle Jiu pointed at Dong Xiaoyu and said softly.
Qiu Yunshui: "Are you still unwilling to enter Neimao?"
Uncle Jiu was silent for a moment and exhaled a puff of white air: "It's still the same as before, 20% of the profits will be given to the master."
